notes: Pre-registered V1 candidates chosen after Phase 2 data exploration. Each window is asymmetric with more post-R than pre-R waveform. Window choice, filtering, and per-window normalization are validation-only experiments (implementation-plan.md Phase 2, ADR 0005).

windows.rationale: Tight QRS-centred window. Minimal neighbour-beat contamination at fast rates; may clip late T-wave morphology used to separate F and V beats.
Captures the QRS plus most of the T-wave at resting heart rates while keeping the pre-R baseline short.
Widest candidate. Retains the full T-wave and some ST segment; risks bleeding into the next beat in tachycardic records (e.g. 207, 208, 233).

filter.implementation: scipy.signal.butter + scipy.signal.filtfilt on the selected lead before windowing
filter.rationale: Standard ambulatory-ECG passband: rejects baseline wander below 0.5 Hz and EMG / 60 Hz mains above 40 Hz. Zero-phase filtering avoids shifting the R-peak. Compared against the raw signal in validation only.
